name: skillta-career-intelligence
title: SkillTa Public Career Intelligence Server
description: Public MCP server providing read-only access to 60 authored tech career roadmaps, 290 learning phases, catalog metrics, and localized 2027 tech salaries across 50 countries.

catalog_index.name: Public Markdown Catalog Manifest
catalog_index.description: Full JSON catalog of 60+ public career roadmaps and country guides.

ai_snapshot.name: Curriculum Statistics Snapshot
ai_snapshot.description: Verified counts of careers, phases, projects, resources, and difficulty distribution.

research_findings.name: Tech Career Catalog Research Analysis
research_findings.description: Authored findings analyzing 60 tech careers and 290 roadmap phases.

llms_full.name: Full Plain-Text LLM Index
llms_full.description: Comprehensive plain-text knowledge dump for LLM ingest.

methodology_faq.name: Catalog Methodology & FAQ
methodology_faq.description: Explanations of career counts, learning difficulty labels, and demand criteria.

tools.name: get_catalog_statistics
tools.description: Returns verified numerical metrics from the SkillTa career catalog (60 careers, 290 phases, 870 topics, 815 projects, 852 resources).

tools.name: fetch_career_roadmap
tools.description: Fetches the full 4-5 phase learning roadmap for a specific tech career (e.g., frontend-developer, ai-ml-engineer, devops-engineer).

career_id.description: The URL slug of the career path, such as frontend-developer or data-scientist.

tools.name: get_country_salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Returns localized 2027 tech salary bands and hiring hubs for one of the 50 supported countries.

country_slug.description: ISO country slug, such as usa, india, united-kingdom, germany, or canada.
